constitution.description: Define or update project principles in constitution.md and check related documents for consistency.
constitution.argument-hint:
[quick|deep | project principles] (optional)

This command creates/updates the project constitution at .codexspec/memory/constitution.md.

Three ways to use:
1. No arguments → Interactive mode: choose exploration depth (quick/deep)
2. quick → Lightweight exploration: config files + README + core entry points (~5-10 files)
3. deep → Full exploration: all of above + source code analysis + architecture patterns
4. <description> → Skip exploration, use your principles directly

Examples:
  /codexspec:constitution
  /codexspec:constitution quick
  /codexspec:constitution deep
  /codexspec:constitution Python FastAPI backend with pytest, focus on type safety

specify.description: Clarify a feature’s goals, scope and constraints, then save confirmed requirements to requirements.md.
specify.argument-hint: Describe the initial idea, or provide an existing feature directory

clarify.description: Resolve gaps, ambiguity and contradictions through focused questions, then synchronize confirmed decisions into requirements.md and spec.md.

analyze.description: Check consistency from requirements through tasks and automatically fix downstream issues supported by confirmed requirements.

checklist.description: Create a checklist for requirement completeness, clarity and scenario coverage, rather than testing code.

generate-spec.description: Turn confirmed requirements into spec.md with feature behavior, error handling and acceptance criteria.

design-to-plan.description: Turn design.md into plan.md with implementation phases, execution order and verification steps.

plan-to-tasks.description: Break plan.md into tasks.md with concrete work, dependencies and verification, including scenarios for testable tasks.

review-spec.description: Review spec.md for requirement coverage and verifiable acceptance criteria, judging readiness for design.

review-plan.description: Review plan.md for implementation steps, ordering and requirement coverage, judging readiness for task breakdown.

review-tasks.description: Review tasks.md for coverage, dependencies and verification, judging whether implementation can begin.

implement-tasks.description: Implement tasks.md, run tests and independent review, and repair verified issues.

tasks-to-issues.description: Create GitHub issues from tasks.md, including relevant files, dependencies and available acceptance criteria.

commit.description: Generate and execute Conventional Commits compliant commit messages based on git status and session context
commit.argument-hint: [-p] Use -p to only preview the message without committing

commit-staged.description: Generate a message strictly from staged changes and execute the authorized commit; use -p to preview without committing.
commit-staged.argument-hint: [-p] Use -p to only preview the message without committing

pr.description: Draft GitHub PR or GitLab MR titles, descriptions and verification guidance from branch differences.

review-code.description: Review Git changes for merge readiness; use --audit to assess existing code quality.
review-code.argument-hint:
[defect-gate selectors | --audit [paths...]] (all arguments optional)

This command reviews code in one of two mutually exclusive modes.

Mode 1 - Defect gate (default): merge-blocking verdict over a Git change.
  1. No arguments → Full feature-branch delta: merge-base → worktree (on the base branch itself: uncommitted delta)
  2. --committed → Merge-base to HEAD only; excludes staged, unstaged, untracked work
  3. --uncommitted → Staged, unstaged, and untracked work only
  4. --commit <sha> → Exactly that commit; add --parent <n> to select one merge parent
  Modifiers never select a target by themselves:
  - --base <branch> → Override base resolution; valid only with No arguments or --committed
  - --feature <feature-dir> → Attach requirements context for coverage; never changes Git scope
  - --focus <instructions> → Add Risk Pass obligations; repeatable, never narrows scope
  - --decided-by reviewer|ask → Who decides out-of-context findings; overrides review.decided_by (default: reviewer)
  - --incremental-from <fingerprint> → Re-review only the repair delta; valid only with No arguments or --committed

Mode 2 - Audit: advisory quality scorecard over current file contents (no gate verdict, no envelope).
  1. --audit → Review the main source directory (default: src/)
  2. --audit <path> [<path>...] → Review only the listed paths, space-separated

A bare path such as src/ is not a valid defect target: migrate it with --audit src/.

Examples:
  /codexspec:review-code
  /codexspec:review-code --uncommitted
  /codexspec:review-code --commit <sha> --parent 1
  /codexspec:review-code --committed --base origin/main
  /codexspec:review-code --feature .codexspec/specs/2026-0714-1030ab-payment --focus "verify retry handling"
  /codexspec:review-code --audit src/api

quick.description: Confirm a small, bounded requirement, then automate specification, planning, tasks, implementation and review.

auto-dev.description: Develop confirmed blueprint requirements in order, from specification to verified implementation and commits.

blueprint.description: Plan multiple features in a shared blueprint, recording confirmed requirements and organizing pending work for auto-dev.
blueprint.argument-hint: Describe a new requirement, or identify a pending requirement to replace, delete, or move

config.description: Interactively configure languages, automation, worktrees and other project options; use --view to inspect settings only.

debug.description: Reproduce a reported failure, trace its root cause, then apply and verify a minimal fix.
debug.argument-hint: [error text | failing test | file:line | plain-language symptom]

distill.description: Capture reusable lessons from interactions in the project profile, or review, revise and consolidate existing records.

evolve.description: Turn vetted, broadly useful project knowledge into commands or skills; open an upstream PR after your approval.
evolve.argument-hint: [what to evolve, or a profile area]

onboard.description: Scan existing code to record conventions and explicit constraints in the project profile, saving constraints after your review.

release-notes.description: Add a CHANGELOG.md entry and draft release notes from Git history, without publishing a release.

reverse-spec.description: Derive an architecture overview or module spec and design from existing code; report differences when a confirmed baseline exists.

review-design.description: Review design.md for requirement coverage and technical feasibility, judging readiness for implementation planning.

spec-to-design.description: Create design.md from spec.md to define components, interfaces and key technical decisions.
